retrievalProfile.description: A three-panel vertical triptych featuring a male performer in motion against a colorful abstract mural with bold red and blue header/footer blocks.
triggerTerms: triptych photo layout with abstract background
bold sans-serif header on red background

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic composition divided into three vertical photographic panels showing a sequence of dance moves. The subject is a man in a dark suit, set against a vibrant, hand-painted abstract background of winding ribbons and geometric shapes. The layout is framed by a thick red header containing high-contrast typography and a blue footer containing a multi-column list.
coreVisualRelationships: Sequential movement across three vertical frames
High-contrast white text against saturated primary color blocks
Organic abstract mural patterns contrasting with the formal suit of the subject
Repetition of a clock motif in each panel to signify time
coreInvariants: Red header block and blue footer block

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject centered in each of the three vertical panels, increasing in kinetic energy from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white sans-serif name in the red header block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down reading of the header, followed by a left-to-right scan of the three photographic panels, ending at the tracklist footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White borders separating the three panels and framing the entire composition.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primary color blocks with a varied, mid-tone palette in the abstract background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight for primary display text
High contrast between script and sans-serif styles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script text features a heavy brush-like stroke with connected lowercase letters
Sans-serif characters have blunt, squared-off terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold uppercase sans-serif for impact paired with a dynamic black script for a 'hand-signed' or informal feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and mid-century feel of the main display text.
Captures the informal, slanted energy of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a triptych of three vertical panels separated by white borders. Each panel features a man in a dark 1960s suit dancing against a colorful abstract mural of winding ribbons. Add a solid red block at the top and a solid blue block at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white uppercase sans-serif text to the right side of the red block and black script text to the left. Add a four-column list of white uppercase text in the blue footer block.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly three vertical panels?
Is the header red and the footer blue?
Is the main text white and uppercase?
Does the background feature abstract winding shapes?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the triptych panels are equal width
Ensure the red and blue blocks are solid and opaque
Verify the script text is legible against the red background
Confirm the subject's suit is dark and formal
Check for the presence of the clock motif in the background
recipe.reuseFormula: Triptych layout + Abstract Mural + Red/Blue color blocking + Heavy Sans-Serif/Script pairing.
